children: The Indonesian parliament's budget committee on Thursday approved total government spending of 4,106.3 trillion rupiah ($231 billion) in the 2027 budget, with the fiscal deficit forecast at 2.40% of GDP, the committee chair said.
The committee also approved a state revenue target of 3,435.1 trillion rupiah, chair Said Abdullah said.
Both figures were 9.1 trillion rupiah higher than the initial budget proposal presented to parliament by President Prabowo Subianto in August.
The budget committee's decision is expected to receive approval in a broader parliamentary vote at a later date.
